citations.quote: Brexanolone was granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation on August 23, 2016 for the treatment of postpartum depression (PPD). The Breakthrough Therapy designation was based on the results of an open-label study (terminated early for efficacy after four patients had a large response) and a phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study (Study 547-PPD-202A).
**Review Priority:** Priority review

summary.text: Brexanolone (Zulresso) was granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation on August 23, 2016 for PPD and received Priority review; approval was supported by two positive adequate and well-controlled trials and was based on standard (not accelerated) approval. It was approved with a boxed warning and a REMS.
